title: Two-surface composite on a lower molar, with weekend small talk

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Hi Mark, how was the lake this weekend?

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: Great, we finally got the boat out to Lake Travis.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Nice. So last time we saw decay on the lower left, let's take care of that today.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Okay, numbing is in. Isolating number nineteen.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Decay on nineteen is mesial and occlusal, it's into dentin but not near the nerve.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: A2 is good. Placing a mesial occlusal composite on nineteen.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Checking the bite. Bite feels even?

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: I also noticed number thirty has a small dark spot on the occlusal, let's watch that and recheck in six months.
